FEAT-2-S99.title: Implement Dual-Pipeline Specialty Identification Logic
FEAT-2-S99.description: Build core domain logic combining regex-based extraction and vector-based semantic matching in parallel, aggregating and deduplicating NUCC specialty codes with confidence scoring.

FEAT-2-S100.title: Integrate Specialty Identification with Provider Search Flow
FEAT-2-S100.description: Connect specialty identification outputs (NUCC codes and classifications) into provider_search_service to enable taxonomy fallback and improve provider retrieval accuracy.

FEAT-2-S101.title: Test Specialty Identification Accuracy and Edge Cases
FEAT-2-S101.description: Create unit and integration tests validating correct mapping of user queries to NUCC codes, including ambiguous queries, multi-specialty inputs, synonym handling, and fallback behavior.
FEAT-2-S101.evidence: GAP: No existing dedicated tests for specialty_service; must be created under backend/tests/
